newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates quoted at steady to higher levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates quoted at steady to higher levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at steady to higher levels on Wednesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session, the exchange said. Eight barges traded versus none on Tuesday.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week of December, traded at 160 percent of tariff.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week of December, traded at 160 percent of tariff.
- Two barges, mid-Mississippi, this week bid at 167-1/2 percent, up 2-1.2 percentage points, no offer.
